mainEntity.name: I'm in the Old Town heritage district. Can I add a sauna?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually, yes. Changes visible from the street can need heritage review. We'll help you check and provide drawings and photos if the town asks.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a building permit in NOTL?

acceptedAnswer.text: An accessory building over 10 m² typically needs a building permit, zoning setbacks apply, and the electrical connection needs an ESA permit. We check before you order.

mainEntity.name: How much does delivery and installation cost in Niagara-on-the-Lake?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario, including Niagara-on-the-Lake. Delivery only is $450. HST is shown separately on every quote.

mainEntity.name: What heater size does my sauna need?

acceptedAnswer.text: We size every heater to the sauna's interior volume plus extra for glass. None of our saunas take less than a 6 kW heater; larger models use 9 to 10.5 kW electric or a wood stove where there's room for its clearances.
